description: Client-side script for managing application storage share folder UI, including permission list layout, data fetching, and user interactions.

methods.name: obj_table_prepare
methods.description: Prepares data objects by assigning names with a prefix and index.

methods.name: permission_list_layout
methods.description: Builds and updates the permission list table in the UI.

methods.name: get_obj_success_cb
methods.description: Callback for successful retrieval of object data, updates UI elements accordingly.

methods.name: get_obj_error_cb
methods.description: Callback for failed object data retrieval.

methods.name: get_info_success_cb
methods.description: Callback for successful storage info retrieval, updates folder list UI.

methods.name: get_info_error_cb
methods.description: Callback for failed storage info retrieval.

methods.name: get_storage_status
methods.description: Initiates retrieval of storage status info.

methods.name: page_initial
methods.description: Initializes page by fetching storage status.

methods.name: add_permission_item
methods.description: Adds a new permission item based on user input.

methods.name: delete_permission_item
methods.description: Deletes a permission item by index or clears all.

methods.name: set_obj_success_cb
methods.description: Callback for successful object setting, shows success message.

methods.name: set_obj_error_cb
methods.description: Callback for failed object setting, handles errors.

methods.name: set_obj_data
methods.description: Sends object data to API for saving.

methods.name: page_save
methods.description: Saves current permission data to storage.
